entries.title: Jeremiah 28:1
segments: ¶And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, [that] Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of Jehovah, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:2
segments: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:3
segments: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of Jehovah's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried to Babylon;

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:4
segments: and I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah that went to Babylon, saith Jehovah: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:5
segments: And the prophet Jeremiah spoke unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:6
segments: And the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen, may Jehovah do so! may Jehovah perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again from Babylon, into this place, the vessels of Jehovah's house, and all them of the captivity!

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:7
segments: Nevertheless, hear, I pray thee, this word which I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people:

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:8
segments: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old, prophesied also concerning many countries and concerning great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:9
segments: The prophet that prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, shall be known as the prophet whom Jehovah hath really sent.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:10
segments: ¶And the prophet Hananiah took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and broke it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:11
segments: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: So will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon within two full years from off the neck of all the nations. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:12
segments: And the word of Jehovah came unto Jeremiah, after that the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:13
segments: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Thou hast broken the yokes of wood, and thou hast made in their place yokes of iron.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:14
segments: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:15
segments: And the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah, Hear now, Hananiah: Jehovah hath not sent thee; and thou makest this people to trust in falsehood.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:16
segments: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, for thou hast spoken revolt against Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:17
segments: And the prophet Hananiah died in the same year in the seventh month.
